fact: ANIE says it has set up a digital platform for company creation and formalisation at its Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprise, and the Moov Money convention of 18 September 2026 adds electronic payment of the fees.
ANIE opened a technical workshop on 18 February 2026 to validate the digitalisation of the Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprise, described as a technical review of the platform.
